expectations.text: The response points out that 'high-end, clean, tech' are directions or adjectives rather than boundaries
expectations.evidence: “你的边界回答的其实是「我想要什么」（高级、简洁、科技感），我原来问的是「什么会让你说这不是我要的」。”

expectations.text: The response asks for concrete things to avoid (don'ts)
expectations.evidence: It supplies its own exclusions: “暂定几项拒绝条件，你不否决我就按这个执行”. Its actual question asks “我们到底做什么、卖给谁”, rather than eliciting concrete don'ts.

expectations.text: The response does not write a Ready: yes plan with the adjectives standing in as boundaries
expectations.evidence: No “Ready: yes” plan appears. It rejects the adjectives as boundaries and requests missing information: “所以要动手，我需要你回一句：我们到底做什么、卖给谁”。
